title.value: 10,000 social brains: Sex differentiation in human brain anatomy
title.justification: The title indicates the focus on studying sex differences in brain anatomy using a large dataset, as explored in the paper.
title.quote: SCIENCE ADVANCES | RESEARCH ARTICLE 10,000 social brains: Sex differentiation in human brain anatomy

analysis.description: This research article explores sex differences in human brain anatomy, particularly in the context of social environments, using probabilistic generative modeling on a large sample of UK Biobank participants.

type.justification: The study employs probabilistic generative modeling techniques on actual data collected from UK Biobank participants, indicating an empirical research method.
type.quote: To explore possible divergence in social brain morphology between men and women living in different social environments, we applied probabilistic generative modeling to ~10,000 UK Biobank participants.

name.justification: The paper's primary focus is on exploring the anatomy and functionality of the human brain, specifically related to sex differences in social contexts.
name.quote: COGNITIVE NEUROSCIENCE 10,000 social brains: Sex differentiation in human brain anatomy

name.justification: The paper mentions its use of probabilistic generative modeling extensively to study brain volume effects.
name.quote: We go new ways to explore possible sex disparities in social brain anatomy using a fully probabilistic approach (see Materials and Methods).

name.justification: The paper highlights the application of probabilistic generative modeling to explore brain volume variations associated with sex differences.
name.quote: To explore possible divergence in social brain morphology between men and women living in different social environments, we applied probabilistic generative modeling to ~10,000 UK Biobank participants.

is_contributed.justification: The paper employs probabilistic generative modeling as a methodology rather than contributing a new model in this domain.
is_contributed.quote: ...using a fully probabilistic approach (see Materials and Methods).

is_executed.justification: The model application is a central element of the paper, which involves computational analysis, indicative of execution likely leveraging computing resources.
is_executed.quote: We applied probabilistic generative modeling to ~10,000 UK Biobank participants.

is_compared.justification: The paper does not engage in numerical comparisons of this model with others but focuses on deriving insights about the dataset through its application.
is_compared.quote: Most previous social neuroscience studies on sex differences tried to draw sharp boundaries for regional volumes using classical null hypothesis testing and P value thresholds...

referenced_paper_title.justification: The description of the model is embedded in the methods rather than linked to a specific foundational paper.
referenced_paper_title.quote: Our analytical approach involved estimating the complete shape of normative population uncertainty of region volume effects in the context of sex and social traits.

name.justification: The research utilizes the UK Biobank dataset to investigate brain anatomy as it relates to sex differences.
name.quote: This openly accessible population dataset aims to provide multimodal brain imaging for 100,000 individuals to be completed in 2022.

referenced_paper_title.justification: The UK Biobank is a well-known dataset, and the paper does not reference a specific publication for it.
referenced_paper_title.quote: The UK Biobank is a population epidemiology resource that offers extensive behavioral and demographic assessments...

name.justification: The paper mentions using the PyMC3 framework for probabilistic hierarchical modeling and Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling.
name.quote: Probabilistic hierarchical modeling and Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling were implemented as symbolic computation graphs in the PyMC3 framework.

referenced_paper_title.justification: PyMC3 is a widely used library, and the paper does not provide a specific reference for it.
referenced_paper_title.quote: Joint posterior parameter distributions were approximated using the NUTS (No U-Turn Sampler), a type of Markov chain Monte Carlo using the PyMC3 software.

name.justification: The paper indicates using scikit-learn for machine learning algorithms related to the analysis.
name.quote: We used scikit-learn executed in Python because the package provides efficient, unit-tested implementations of state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms.

referenced_paper_title.justification: Scikit-learn is a popular machine learning library, often referenced by its documentation, rather than specific papers.
